_comment: Use cases the product suite does not name, each with the reason it does not. Derived by scripts/use_case_ledger.py and held to the tree in both directions by tests/test_use_case_ledger.py. A reason is a sentence about the cell, not a note that nobody got to it.

empty.anything_code: `Schema::Anything` is the top, which admits every value, so the walk has no failure to report against one and the arm is the table's fallback
empty.intersection_error: a meet reports its failing member rather than itself, so the arm is reached only through a node with no members -- which the constructors fold to the top before a walk sees it
empty.object_type: an attribute record is a meet with the class it came from, so a value of the wrong type is refused by `instance_type` first and the arm stands for a bare attribute record, which the frontend does not build
empty.recursion: a reference reports through the definition it names, so the walk carries the definition's own code rather than this one
empty.unresolved_recursion: the marker a builder leaves behind, resolved before a validator is returned: a compiled schema holds none
empty.validation_error: the exception's own type name, carried where a report is built from no violation at all: a caller who constructs one by hand. It is the class rather than a code a walk chooses
